scope: Egypt medical discovery — Ain Shams University Faculty of Medicine / Extended Medical Program

institution.canonicalName: Ain Shams University Faculty of Medicine
institution.programme: Bachelor Degree of Medicine and General Surgery / Extended Medical Program

verifiedFacts.claim: Ain Shams Faculty of Medicine's international-student office states that non-Egyptian Bachelor Degree of Medicine and General Surgery applicants apply through Study in Egypt, hold a high-school diploma or equivalent, and complete required application documents.

The official Extended Medical Program opens 2026/27 applications on 15 April 2026 and closes them on 31 August 2026. Its international applicants must use Study in Egypt, pass English and IT examinations plus an interview, and pay a USD 350 application fee.
The official EMP fee page publishes 2026/27 instalments for Years 1 to 5 in Egyptian pounds and describes EMP as an integrated programme.

holdReasons: The 2026/27 EMP fee page does not state whether its Egyptian-pound instalments apply to non-Egyptian students; using them as an international tuition amount would be unsupported.

The official international admission page confirms the general Medicine and Surgery route, while the EMP page describes a distinct integrated programme. The sources do not establish whether the fee schedule and entry requirements represent the same catalogue offering for foreign students.
No current independent programme-level recognition/accreditation record was established for the Ain Shams Medicine offering, so the required 2–3 recognition badges cannot be supported.
The sources do not provide a complete current programme-specific curriculum/clinical and accommodation evidence bundle at the required depth.
nextAction: Obtain Ain Shams or Study in Egypt confirmation that identifies the foreign programme, total 2026/27 tuition and associated charges, and obtain a current independent programme-accreditation record before packaging.
